content: Làbɔ̈ɔ̈n a Klistɔ
Abun, isàkal naa un'tüüb abɛ anà Klistɔ afàlapà ngwal, ndɛɛl unsà ukwen ande, anà un'tüüb anà nde u mbwo a Dweelà, ngyɛb anà ubwaŋ uboo a bɛ,
apan, làyööl mpem amɛ a un'sak mbɔɔn mukal mun mwɛy, ukwen mwɛy, an'kyän an'mwɛy anà un'tüüb mwɛy.
Twon làkyer akà undiir mwɛy unsà isür, itàkal unsà làkoo làkɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ, wɛɛ, anà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n, lawɛl atɔŋ asànaa ba ban'söön bɛ ŋakwo.
Wɛy mbuur ukɔ̈ɔ̈n aler ndaa ande ŋakwo mpɛl, wɛɛ nde uler sye ndaa a baar bumwɛy.
Làkäl anà ifà a tub aki amu bɛ, ifà kyàkäl amu Yɛsu Klistɔ:

content.text: nde kàwɛl anki wa asànaa undiir agyɔɔr mukal balàbal anà Nzam.
Wɛɛ nde kàkɔɔb ya yanswà kàkäl nde ayà,
nde kàtyeey nde ŋakwo anà kàswɛŋ unkyeey
tii kà ukwà, itàkal ukwà a kulunsi.
Kyakin Nzam kun'sɛn nde u dudu u mbwo a kab a ngway
anà kun'pɛ nde ikɔb kyan'söön ikɔb byanswà,
ntɔn naa kà ikɔb a Yɛsu,
u du, u mɛɛn anà ungyɛl a mɛɛn,
anà ndaa yanswà yàtɛ imbäl naa:

content: An'pɛɛlà u mɛɛn

Kyakin, nkween amɛ, bɛ baar làfàkal aŋunkyeey taaŋ lanswà, làkäl abun kà nà u mii amɛ mpel anki, wɛɛ aŋàsöönà apanà mpa in'wà mɛ paa! Làsyääl ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ unsà bɔɔmà anà matɛɛr,
ntɔn wà Nzam afàsal uboo a bɛ anà afàlapà ngyal mukwen anà mukyer ndaa yanswà asànaa kàlɔ̈n nde unsà ukwen ande.
Làkyer indiir byanswà ukɔɔn in'ŋün anà mbaaŋ,

ntɔn bɛ làkɔɔn akal anà pɛl, làkäl ankɔr anà bàŋàpɔŋà, baan a Nzam bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ube uboo a baar abɛ bà mɛɛn mà abye anà an'kyän an'be. Uboo aba bɛ làbàmupà in'ŋyäŋ asànaa ndem a mbaa u mɛɛn
ntɔn bɛ lamɛɛy ndaa a mɔ̈ɔ̈. Abun, bɛ làsàkal ngaal amɛ kà ilä usàyà Klistɔ, ntɔn kà abunàbun anki mɛ kàsäl anà kàmɛn ntaan.
Wɛɛ, itàkal naa mɛ an'tyaŋà asànaa man itàkal may udu a ibɔɔn anà isal a làkwikilà abɛ, mɛ in'wà unsà un'sak anà musaŋ anà bɛ banswà.
Wɛɛ itàkal bɛ sye, làkal kà un'sak mutüüb anà mɛ.
Tumàtɛ anà Ɛpafrɔdit
Amu Mwol Yɛsu, mɛ in'wɛ anà làkyän mukàlatööm Tumàtɛ itaan a mbɔɔn tɛy, ntɔn mɛ in'wɛl ndɛɛl unsà làsaŋ abɛ uyan'twääl nde.
Nà nde mpɛl afàkab an'kyän anà mɛ, anà afàman mpay ndandaa ntɔn ubwaŋ abɛ.
Ntɔn baar banswà bàfàleŋ ubwaŋ aba ŋakwo, wɛɛ kà bà Yɛsu Klistɔ anki.
Kyekà, bɛ làkyàyöb naa Tumàtɛ kàkyàswaŋ lää ande: asànaa mwan anà taarànde, nde kàbääb anà mɛ unsà isal a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ.
Kyakin mɛ in'we anà làkyän mukàlatööm awà umpal in'yàyöb mɛ naa ndaa amɛ yan'tsü aben.
Mɛ in'wɛ anà làkyän unsà Mwol naa mɛ ŋakwo in'kyer ayàlaler itaan a mbɔɔn tɛy.
Wɛɛ apanà, mɛ in'manà naa yà mfun naa mɛ alàtööm un'tɔŋ amɛ Ɛpafrɔdit, mbuur ifàsal bi anà ifànwaan bi ità anà nde, mbuur awà lan'tööm bɛ mukambay unsà indiir kàkäl mɛ abyà mfun,
ntɔn nde kàkäl anà ngyal mbɔɔn mufàlaman bɛ banswà anà nde kàmɛnà mpay mbɔɔn u mpem ntɔn làwem bɛ làsaŋ a ukyal ande.
Inye, nde kàkäl anà ukyal, tsütsü mukwà, wɛɛ Nzam kun'wem ngyɛb, kà nde mpɛl anki, wɛɛ mɛ sye, ntɔn mɛ mukɔɔn aman ngyɛb udu a ngyɛb.
Lalan mɛ an'kyer làgyägyä mufàlatööm awà, umpal làyuman bɛ, bɛ làkäl unsà un'sak, anà mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n akal anà ngyɛb mbɔɔn.
Lun'wɛl unsà un'sak wanswà unsà Mwol anà lakömà baar a tub abà.
Ntɔn nde kàkyer alàkwà ntɔn isal a Klistɔ: nde kàsi mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande unsà igɔnsà ntɔn mukan'pà mbaay làlàkwo bɛ ŋakwo mukan'pà.
